objects.name: Returns Row Count Informal Range
objects.description: No formal check, but typically 400-600 rows per bi-weekly period; flag if empty or under ~50.

objects.name: Validate Returns Data Date Range
objects.description: Confirm the Return Date column (A) falls within the expected bi-weekly window.

objects.name: Standardize Return Reason Values
objects.description: Manual find-and-replace to normalize inconsistent CRM export values (e.g. 'Product Defect' -> 'Defective'); no lookup table exists for this, unlike Revenue's region mapping.

objects.name: Manual Standardization Error Risk
objects.description: Return Reason standardization relies on a manual, undocumented substitution list rather than a lookup table, making it error-prone and hard to hand off.

objects.name: Refresh & Publish Returns Dashboard
objects.description: Refresh Returns_Dashboard.pbix and publish; destination workspace believed to be 'Ops Analytics Workspace' but not confirmed by the outgoing owner.

objects.name: Returns Workspace Name Unconfirmed
objects.description: Outgoing owner was not certain of the exact Power BI Service workspace name for the Returns dashboard and said he would confirm later.

objects.name: Inventory Aging Report Refresh & Distribution
objects.description: Monthly refresh/publish/distribution of the Inventory Aging report for the Supply Chain Director and warehouse managers.

objects.name: SAP MM Module
objects.description: Materials-management module of SAP; source system for the Inventory Aging extract, output as a pipe-delimited TXT file at month end.
